Corollary
[Hamilton--Ivey estimate without normalization] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0046 ↗ thm:chow-ii-hamilton-ivey 1. ch10:10.18\group Ricci-flow applications

If $C=\inf _x u (x,0)>0$ in dimension three, then at every point where $ u <0$, \[ R\ge | u | igl(\log | u |+\log (C^{-1}+t)-3 igr). \]
Proof

\sketch Apply the normalized estimate after parabolic rescaling by $C$ and undo the scaling of curvature and time.

□
